title: AdmPhaseRecord
description: TOGAF-sourced justification archetype — ADM Phase Record. Defines the property vocabulary for contextualizing architecture work within TOGAF's Architecture Development Method (ADM) cycle. Rootless archetype — used to type phase execution records in governance justification. TOGAF mapping: ADM Phase (Architecture Development Method — the iterative cycle of phases that produce architecture deliverables). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Development Method).

phase.description: TOGAF ADM phase. Preliminary + Phases A through H map to the ADM circle; Requirements Management is the central hub phase. TOGAF mapping: canonical ADM phase identifiers.

status.description: Phase execution status. ITERATED = phase was completed but re-entered in a subsequent ADM iteration cycle.

iterationId.description: Identifier for the ADM iteration/cycle this phase record belongs to. Links related phase records within the same ADM execution.
